messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-4621 — synthetic canary 'canary-probe-apac' failing DNS lookup (NXDOMAIN/timeout) >30% in last 3m. Auto-escalation to APAC oncall.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-4621 created and routed to APAC Oncall (SRE).
Maya Singh: acked — I'm oncall. Observing spike in resolver errors from apac probe fleet, mostly to edge-cdn-hosts. No app 5xx spikes yet.
Luis Ramirez: @Maya I'm here — any recent infra or cert flips? I merged the edgedeploy PR earlier but that was cert chain update for origin, not DNS.
infra-alerts-bot: recent deploys: edgedeploy v2.9.1 merged 12m ago (origin cert chain); dns-config PR #314 merged 9m ago — changed resolver list to use internal-resolver-2.
Maya Singh: that dns-config PR matches timing. Canary failures started ~8m ago. Rolling back dns-config to previous resolver set might fix probe resolution.
Luis Ramirez: confirming: the new resolver returns SERVFAIL for some external domains due to ACL mismatch. We've seen this in staging once. Low-risk rollback.
Maya Singh: plan: 1) suppress duplicate pages for 10m, 2) rollback dns-config in apac prober pool, 3) monitor canary and app metrics, 4) notify customer-ops.
Customer-Ops Bot: Notifying customer-ops: two customers have active deploy tests in APAC within 30m — they are being alerted.
Maya Singh: suppressing fanout now: incident-bot: suppress-pager INC-2026-4621 duration=10m reason="config rollback in flight"
Incident Bot: Pager suppression applied for INC-2026-4621 by Maya Singh (10m).
Luis Ramirez: rollback command ready:
```
kubectl -n synthetic set env daemonset/prober RESOLVERS="8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1" --record
# or helm rollback
helm upgrade synth-prober ./charts/synth-prober --set probe.resolvers={8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1} --namespace synthetic
```
Maya Singh: running helm update to restore resolvers in apac region...
Maya Singh: helm applied, forcing rolling restart of probe pool (apac-prober-0..3).
infra-alerts-bot: probe pods restarting: apac-prober-0 Restarting (1/4), apac-prober-1 Restarting (2/4), apac-prober-2 Restarting (3/4), apac-prober-3 Restarting (4/4).
Luis Ramirez: I see DNS resolution success rates climbing back up on the probe dashboard.
Maya Singh: monitoring: canary dns_failure_rate_apac: 0.42 -> 0.06 in last 90s. No increase in production 5xx.
Customer-Ops Bot: customer notifications sent: customerA@example.com, customerB@example.com — message: "We observed probe noise in APAC; your tests may have flapped. We're rolling back probe DNS config and monitoring."
Maya Singh: leaving suppression for 5 more minutes to ensure stability. Any objections to resolving PD after 20m stable?
Luis Ramirez: fine. For RCA: root cause = dns-config PR changed resolvers to internal-resolver-2 which has ACLs blocking some external hostnames. Action items: add resolver smoke tests to PR pipeline, add canary gating for resolver changes.
Maya Singh: filing incident note and actions. Incident Bot: adding label "synthetic-dns" severity=P2 comment="no confirmed customer-impact beyond probe noise"
PagerDuty: INC-2026-4621 acknowledged by Maya Singh at 2026-06-02T03:05:21Z
Incident Bot: timeline saved; alert suppression expires in 5m.
Maya Singh: visible stability for 10m now. I'll wait 20m then resolve. Thanks @Luis for rollback help.
Luis Ramirez: quick follow-up: I'll open a follow-up PR to reintroduce internal-resolver-2 but only after we modify ACLs and add e2e resolution tests.
Maya Singh: resolving now as stable:
PagerDuty: INC-2026-4621 resolved by Maya Singh at 2026-06-02T03:13:10Z (status: resolved)
Maya Singh: postmortem owners: Luis Ramirez (config fix) and Maya Singh (canary gating + suppression playbook update). Actionables: add resolver smoke tests to CI, add PR checklist item for DNS resolver changes, and add runbook snippet for immediate suppression when probe config changes.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-4621 closed; transcript archived to incidents bucket.
